rows.note: Use 武術 as the all-purpose term for a codified fighting discipline, whether armed or unarmed.

example.english: Taekwondo is a martial art, and Ming has studied it since he was little.
example.traditional: 跆拳道係一種武術，阿明由細到大都有學。
example.jyutping: toi4 kyun4 dou6 hai6 jat1 zung2 mou5 seot6 aa3 ming4 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 jau5 hok6

rows.note: Use 功夫 when you specifically mean Chinese kung fu or martial-arts skill, rather than a named non-Chinese discipline.

example.english: I learned a Chinese martial art from Master Lee when I was young, and I still practise every day.
example.traditional: 我細個跟李師傅學過功夫，依家仲日日練。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 gan1 lei5 si1 fu2 hok6 gwo3 gung1 fu1 ji1 gaa1 zung6 jat6 jat6 lin6
